title: Transformation Entity
description: JSON Schema for Transformation entity in customer workspace. Transformations are pure functions that mutate/enrich events within a workflow flow. Each transformation references its workflow via workflow_id and its upstream entity (connection or previous transformation) via upstream_entity_id.

upstream_entity_id.description: Reference to the upstream entity in the flow graph (connection, previous transformation, or the Records data product Studio inserts after a REST trigger). Null only when this is the first transformation directly after the trigger connection.

upstream_entity_type.description: Entity type of the upstream entity (connections, transformations, or data-products)

input_schema.description: Optional: JSON Schema of input events (for validation and type checking). Any JSON Schema object.

output_schema.description: Optional: JSON Schema of output events after transformation (typically inferred). Any JSON Schema object.

order.description: Default execution order when used in workflows (lower = earlier)

batch_size.description: Runtime tuning: events per handler call (rstreams offload batch). Does not cap events read per run; that is bounded by the Lambda timeout and memory thresholds. Unset: 300. Out-of-range values fail deploy.

runtime_memory_mb.description: Runtime tuning: shared runtimes Lambda memory tier (transformers-{mb}). Unset: derived from transform_type (256/512/1024). Any other value fails deploy.

created_by.description: User ID who created the transformation

updated_by.description: User ID who last updated the transformation

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when transformation was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when transformation was last updated

deleted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when transformation was deleted (soft delete)

output_queue_display_name.description: Observe label for this transformation's output queue. Deploy writes it onto the existing queue id and leaves bindings, checkpoints, and bot pause unchanged. Unset: the generated label stays the fallback and is not overwritten.

error_queue_display_name.description: Observe label for this transformation's error queue. Deploy writes it onto the existing queue id and leaves bindings, checkpoints, and bot pause unchanged. Unset: the generated label stays the fallback and is not overwritten.
